records.tagline: A widget to chat with customers from your Discord server
records.description: Turn Discord into your support desk and chat with your customers. Embed our chat widget in 5 minutes and let your customers reach out to you directly to your server. Every conversation in the widget becomes a Discord thread. Unlimited seats, unlimited domains. Deskcord is built for solo founders and small teams. Skip the bloated and expensive tools and get closer to your customers from the comfort of your Discord server. Deskcord is an alternative to the giants like Intercom, Crisp or Zendesk.

records.name: ZeroBill
records.tagline: Bring your development bills close to $0
records.description: ZeroBill brings startup credits, grants, software discounts, and free tiers into one searchable directory. Explore offers, check eligibility, and find savings on the tools you need to build and grow. Spend less time hunting for deals and keep more of your runway.

records.name: Outlier
records.tagline: Private, offline Claude & ChatGPT alternative for your Mac
records.description: A private, offline alternative to Claude and ChatGPT for Apple silicon Macs. The paged MoE engine runs models bigger than your RAM — the 397B Plus tier on a 64 GB Mac. Chat plus a coding agent that reads your codebase, edits files and runs your tests, with Wi-Fi off. Free tiers stay free, no caps. Founders Lifetime is $249 once: no subscription, no renewal, 30-day money-back. macOS 26+, M1–M4.

records.name: FoundrRadio
records.tagline: Pick a frequency, launch your radio station and go on air
records.description: FoundrRadio is an internet radio platform where founders could own their own radio stations and go on air. Visitors could listen to their favourite founders, their talks or music they love. An opportunity to own a small corner on the internet. An attempt to combine nostalgia and community.

records.name: ConflictOSINT
records.tagline: Global events, official sources and AI analysis in one place
records.description: Follow geopolitical developments without juggling dozens of tabs. ConflictOSINT brings signals linked to original reports, official releases, major-event rooms and AI-assisted analysis into one dashboard. Explore the core site free; optional Pro adds deeper research and alert tools.

records.name: Hire VA
records.tagline: Hire Virtual Assistant & Project Manager in 24 Hours
records.description: HireVA: Pre-vetted virtual assistants for GoHighLevel, CRM automation, WordPress, and project management setups.

records.name: Calculadora Alicia
records.tagline: Calculadora en español que explica operaciones paso a paso
records.description: Calculadora Alicia es una herramienta gratuita en español pensada para estudiantes, docentes y familias. No solo da el resultado: muestra el procedimiento completo paso a paso, con llevadas, préstamos y explicaciones, para que los alumnos entiendan de verdad cada operación. Incluye sumas, restas, multiplicación, división, álgebra y más. Sin registro y gratis.

records.name: Hallucination Detector by Komplex AI
records.tagline: - Catch LLM hallucinations before they ship
records.description: A hallucination detector for LLM output, from Komplex AI. Paste any AI response and get a calibrated probability that it's hallucinated, plus the type of error — fabricated facts, fake citations, misleading claims. Use it from a web app, a REST API, Python/JS SDKs, a LangChain integration, an n8n node, or an MCP server. Free tier, zero data retention. Probabilistic, and honest about its limits.

records.name: Ladybug Animated Wear OS Watch Face
records.tagline: A moving ladybug counts the seconds on your Wear OS watch
records.description: Bring a little nature to your Wear OS watch. A ladybug crawls around a leaf, completing one lap every minute as your second hand. Choose realistic or cartoon artwork, day and night palettes, and customizable layouts. No account or companion phone app needed. Requires Wear OS 4+.

records.name: HEIC to PNG Converter
records.tagline: Free online tool to convert iPhone HEIC images to PNG instan
records.description: Convert HEIC images into universally compatible PNG files directly in your browser. Fast, private, and free.

records.name: AI Hairstyle Fit
records.tagline: Try a haircut on your photo, take a brief to your barber
records.description: Choose a practical haircut from your photo and preferences. AI Hairstyle Fit edits hair with the goal of preserving your face and skin details. Compare the preview with your original, download a barber brief with cutting instructions, and follow daily styling steps. One-time credit packs, no subscription. Photos and results are cleared from our service after 24 hours.

records.name: bawkterm
records.tagline: A desktop client for SSH, SFTP, Docker over SSH
records.description: A desktop client for SSH, SFTP, Docker over SSH and Remote Desktop, on Windows and Linux. - GitHub - juddisjudd/bawkterm: A desktop client for SSH, SFTP, Docker over SSH and Remote Desktop, on Windows and Linux.

records.name: AI Grid Lab
records.tagline: Turn ideas into fully deployed web apps using AI
records.description: AI Grid Lab is an AI-powered platform that helps founders and teams turn ideas into launch-ready digital projects with product briefs, task generation, live preview, AI edits, deployment workflows, and continuous improvement.

records.name: RyperDeck
records.tagline: The Windows controller you already own.
records.description: Turn any Android phone or tablet into an ultra-fluid liquid glass wireless macro deck for Windows 11 & 10. 100% free forever, zero latency, limitless pages, UDP local sync, 100% private by design.

records.name: Reassign
records.tagline: Your day, shaped into a story. The planner for makers
records.description: Let the shape of your day tell the story. Reassign is a 24-hour circular planner for busy makers. Midnight up top, noon at the bottom. Drag to block time. Reshape it when plans fall apart. It speaks AI. Brain-dump or brainstorm into the command palette and watch AI rebuild your afternoon, live. It mirrors everything. Google Calendar, Outlook, Todoist, Linear, all in two-way sync. Plus focus mode and an energy curve from your sleep. One dial. Every source. Full control.

records.name: Sonic Refine
records.tagline: Remove noise, breaths & silence on your PC — no uploads
records.description: Sonic Refine is a Windows app that cleans your voice recordings and videos in one click. It removes noise, breaths (even the fake ones AI voices add) and dead air, then evens out loudness. For video, it compresses big files, converts formats, and turns 16:9 into 9:16 by following the face. AI runs on your own CPU, so nothing is uploaded: no queue, no GPU, no per-hour bills. Made for AI voice creators, podcasters and editors. Free for 2 hours a month, no account needed.

records.name: SaptaCraft
records.tagline: Software Development Company Arizona
records.description: At Saptacraft, we are passionate about creating innovative digital solutions that drive business growth and transform user experiences. With years of expertise in software development, web design, and cutting-edge technologies, we help businesses navigate the digital landscape with confidence. Software Development Custom software solutions tailored to your business needs with modern technologies. More Info : https://saptacraft.com/

records.name: CoreLink 3D
records.tagline: Minimalist 3D scene editor или Web-based 3D scene editor
records.description: CoreLink 3D is a minimalist, web-based 3D scene editor built with Babylon.js and WebGPU. Designed as a clean, standalone workspace for 3D enthusiasts and developers, it focuses on core modeling workflows and performance without the clutter.

records.name: Ubic
records.tagline: Parallel calling for B2B sales teams
records.description: Ubic is a parallel dialer for B2B sales teams. Call prospects from your CRM lists, qualify conversations, and organize follow-up in one workspace. Ubic connects to your existing tools and is available in English and French.

records.name: Galería privada
records.tagline: Galería de fotos segura y bóveda fotográfica privada
records.description: Galería de fotos segura y bóveda fotográfica privada

records.name: Luddo House
records.tagline: Play Luddo with friends at a 3D table. Join from a link.
records.description: Luddo House puts Luddo night at a realistic 3D table in a furnished room. Make a private room, share a link, and friends join from any browser with just a name. Set your own house rules or put the table on a TV. No ads, no betting, nothing for sale.

records.name: X (formerly Twitter)
records.tagline: Cooking dinner
records.description: Grab your skillet and let’s get sizzling! Try this recipe tonight and tag your creation with. (Click here to access the E-book ).➡️🔥🎁🎁👉https://t.co/XJSaUSHTWd

records.name: RSS Reader by deeweb
records.tagline: A simple RSS reader that follows you across devices
records.description: A free, clean RSS/Atom reader that syncs across devices. Folders, inline podcasts & YouTube, OPML import/export, auto-refresh, and a Chrome extension with an unread badge and one-click feed detection. Available in English and French.

records.name: Updainium
records.tagline: Get desktop app updates straight from the source
records.description: Updainium is a free, open-source desktop app (built with Tauri & Svelte) that lets you track, download, and install application updates directly from their original sources—like GitHub Releases, GitLab, or RSS feeds. Say goodbye to centralized app stores and keep your tools up to date on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

records.name: LEO - AI Assistant Bot
records.tagline: LEO is an AI Assistant that helps you in your daily lives.
records.description: Meet LEO — Your Voice-Powered Windows AI Assistant LEO is a voice-powered AI assistant designed to make interacting with your Windows computer easier and more convenient. Simply say “Computer” and give LEO a command. LEO combines AI, speech recognition, and Windows automation to help with everyday tasks. What's Included: LEO v1.0.0 Windows application Windows installer Setup instructions Customer README Launch Offer To celebrate the launch, the first customer gets 30% OFF LEO v1.0.0.

records.name: jsontoimg - Beta
records.tagline: A template editor that renders images from JSON
records.description: You draw a template, name the layers that change, then send JSON. jsontoimg fills those layers and returns a PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF or PDF. Use it for Open Graph cards, certificates, tickets and product banners: one layout, a file per record. Call it from the API, n8n, the CLI or MCP. Name a layer and that name is the key. Pin a version so an edit does not break a live render. Credits are images and PDF pages only. 25 lifetime images free, no card. Prepaid packs from $5, or Starter at $29/mo.

records.name: ParrotVoice.app
records.tagline: Let voice AI make calls from your own phone
records.description: Let your AI make and answer real calls for you. ParrotVoice connects it to your own phone over Bluetooth, using your existing number. Give it a goal, and it handles the conversation and reports back. Follow live transcripts and send private instructions while it talks. Works with regular calls and compatible apps like WhatsApp, WeChat and Messenger. Choose your voice model, bring your own key, or connect an agent via MCP. Keep your phone. Keep your number.

records.name: 7 AI Agents for Productivity
records.tagline: 7 AI Agents for Productivity
records.description: Productivity isn't just about doing more—it is about reducing unnecessary work. Discover AI agents that can help organize tasks, manage information, automate workflows, and keep your day moving. https://giftcard-it1h.surge.sh

records.name: Pain Relief Oil Ayurvedic 100ml
records.tagline: Pain Relief Oil
records.description: Do your joints and muscles feel tired? Try our ayurvedic pain relief oil. It comes in a 100ml bottle. It is made with herbs. People in India have used herbs for many, many years. Massage it slowly. It feels warm and nice. Your body can feel calm and light. Use it in the morning or at night. It is easy to use. It smells like fresh herbs. Mom, dad, and grandma can use it too. Make massage time a happy time. Get it now at brawnherbal.com.

records.name: CasaPubblica
records.tagline: Offer hospitality, look for accommodation
records.description: CasaPubblica is a home-sharing app. With its built-in messaging system, it allows users to request and offer accommodation

records.name: HEIC to JPG Converter by PNG Helper
records.tagline: Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG instantly in browser
records.description: PNG Helper is a free, fast, and privacy-focused online tool designed to quickly convert Apple HEIC images into standard JPG files. Key Features: Instant Browser Conversion: Convert files directly in your browser without uploading heavy photos to third-party servers. Zero Software Installation: Works on Windows, Mac, Android, and Linux. Batch Processing Support: Easily handle multiple files at once. 100% Free: No account required, no file size limits, and no hidden subscriptions.

records.name: Broadbeach – La Porchetta
records.tagline: Restaurant in Broadbeach
records.description: Looking for a restaurant in Broadbeach? La Porchetta brings authentic Italian flavours with pizza, pasta, family dining and takeaway options. Visit today!

records.name: Koozy
records.tagline: Live multiplayer quizzes, without the projector.
records.description: Koozy is a real-time multiplayer quiz platform where hosts create quizzes with AI or manually, and players join instantly using a simple game PIN. No app downloads, no accounts for players.

records.name: Filtored: Ai Gallery & Cleanup
records.tagline: Your gallery filtered and sorted.
records.description: Filtored is a photo gallery and cleanup app that works fully offline. Use it as your everyday photo gallery, while also keeping your library clean and organized. Find similar photos, remove the ones you don’t need, organize albums, search by people and categories, without sending your photos to the cloud. No account or cloud uploads. Your photos and data stay on your phone. If you want a private gallery that also helps you keep your photo library under control, Filtored brings both into one app.

records.name: CodewithChat
records.tagline: Build website and web apps with AI
records.description: CodewithChat is an autonomous AI software engineering mentor that helps you design, build, and deploy production-ready full-stack applications step-by-step from natural language prompts.

records.name: KidsLearnCash
records.tagline: A family app for kids' allowance, chores and savings goals
records.description: KidsLearnCash is a free family money app: track kids' allowance, run a chore board with rewards, set savings goals and wishlists, and teach real-world money skills — no bank account needed.

records.name: Listen — Music Map & Stats
records.tagline: Your Apple Music as a world map, charts and stats
records.description: Listen turns your Apple Music history into a world map: every artist you play lights up the country they come from. Tap any country to hear its sound — even North Korea has a playlist. Beyond the map: top artists, tracks and genres built on your real lifetime play counts, stats cards (minutes, decades, chart crossover, night vs day) and story videos made for sharing. Works with Apple Music on iPhone. 3-day free trial.

records.name: WhenModelReset
records.tagline: Track usage-limit reset times for AI subscriptions
records.description: WhenModelReset helps AI subscribers track when usage limits reset. Follow confirmed Codex reset announcements, source links and historical intervals, with optional personal countdowns for Claude Code and Grok usage windows. It separates confirmed resets, announcements and banked credits, and includes a community reset poll. Free and independent; it does not access your accounts or reset your quota.

records.name: Genify
records.tagline: Create AI images and videos across leading models
records.description: Use Genify to create AI images and short videos from text or references. Compare multiple models, review credits before generating, and track every task in one Workspace.

records.name: CRUNITE
records.tagline: Car clubs, meets, cruises and build logs on one live map
records.description: CRUNITE is the home base for car culture — one live map for your whole crew. Go Live so people can find you, drop Flares for instant pop-up meets, and use walkie-talkie mode on cruises so nobody gets lost. Log your build, manage your club with Crew Codes and event planners, discover public meets near you, and stay safe with Crew SOS, Stolen Ride Alerts, and Safe Zones. Free on iOS and Android. Try the Beta Now!

records.name: WorkTime
records.tagline: From team chat messages to a ready hourly invoice
records.description: Write + when you start and − when you finish in your Telegram work chat. WorkTime turns those messages into an editable timesheet, reports by task and by person, and a PDF invoice you send to the client from your own email. For teams of 2–15 people or a single freelancer. No boards, sprints or tickets. Sign in with Telegram, no passwords. Free.

records.name: adtribute
records.tagline: Turn Data Into Your Competitive Advantage
records.description: adtribute is marketing attribution and analytics software for e-commerce brands and lead-gen companies. It combines true first-party tracking with customizable attribution and reporting to deliver accurate and unique insights, and a built-in MCP server connects your data to AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT for trustworthy answers, custom reports, and automation. Not one-size-fits-all but a tailor-made solution, backed by a dedicated data team for setup and ongoing configuration and recommendations.

records.name: Setlyst
records.tagline: Setlists, lyrics and chords for playing live, even offline
records.description: For musicians who play live. Add your own songs with lyrics, chords, key and BPM, build setlists and read them on a phone or tablet on stage, with a metronome and key transposition. It keeps working without internet. Free during the beta.

records.name: Grace
records.tagline: Make your Claude Code plan go further
records.description: A Claude Code plugin for Mac. On 34 tasks: ≈ −45 % of the 5-hour limit (calculGrace helps Claude Code users get more from the plan they already have. In our 34-task side-by-side test, the same workload used 44% of the 5-hour limit without Grace and 25% with Grace. Quality was 91% vs 94% on the 31 paired tasks that completed. Grace is live now, and the first 24 hours are free.ated, other usage removed); quality 91 % vs 94 % on 31 of them.

records.name: modelsentiment
records.tagline: Which AI model does Reddit actually like?
records.description: How Reddit feels about each AI model, per version (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen and more), as a 0–100 index over the last 7 days. Every number carries its 95% interval and the number of opinions behind it, so you can see when a lead is real. Each model page shows the reading day by day, what people praise and criticise, and its Arena and benchmark ranks beside it: opinion, not capability. Free, no signup, never shows post text.

records.name: Timelive
records.tagline: See exact time now and more!
records.description: What time is it now? The exact time, synced to atomic clocks, plus your clock’s accuracy, time zone, daylight saving dates and sunrise for 3,200+ cities. Fast, private, no ads.

records.name: Nature's Shrine: Idle Loot RPG
records.tagline: android, rpg game, idle rpg, mobile games
records.description: Nature's Shrine is a pixel-art idle / wave-survival RPG. You fight endless waves of enemies that get tougher the longer you survive, with a powerful boss appearing every 5th wave.

records.name: Unsub: Subscription Manager
records.tagline: Bill & Expense Tracker
records.description: Stop silent money drain! Track recurring bills, manage free trials, and get smart renewal alerts. 100% private and local - no bank account linking required.

records.name: Azokle Search — Browser & Tor
records.tagline: A privacy-first browser with private search and built-in Tor
records.description: Azokle Search is a privacy-first browser combining private search, browsing, and built-in Tor in one simple experience. Block ads and trackers, browse with Tor, and search the web without unnecessary tracking. Built for people who want a fast, clean browsing experience with privacy at its core.

records.name: VS Pickleball
records.tagline: The browser pickleball game that isn't tennis in disguise
records.description: Most pickleball games online are tennis with a green ball. VS Pickleball keeps the rules that make the sport its own: an enforced kitchen, the two-bounce rule, underhand serves, rally scoring to 11. Play singles or doubles vs AI on three difficulties, 2-player on one keyboard, or a six-round tournament. Build a player with six stats and pick from eight courts. Free, no account, no download — runs in any browser on phone or desktop.

records.name: PDFFreeHub
records.tagline: Free, simple PDF tools that work in your browser
records.description: PDFFreeHub provides free and simple PDF tools that work directly in your browser. Convert PDF to Word, Word to PDF, JPG to PDF and PDF to JPG, or easily merge, split, compress and rotate PDF files. No complicated steps — just choose a tool, upload your file and get the job done quickly.

records.name: Hotel Lobby AI
records.tagline: Hotel Lobby AI Video Generator | AI Rap from Photos
records.description: Make a Hotel Lobby AI rap video from two photos. You and a friend in the orange booth, one hanging mic, ready for TikTok and Reels. From $5.99, no app.
